summary_bullets: Reuse the design scout filter for Step 2 external coder sidecars
Cover reserved-slug filtering, all-reserved success, and stdout-envelope isolation
commit_message:
Reuse design scout filter in Step 2

Delegate external coder scout sidecar normalization to the design scout wrapper so reserved static plan-review slugs are filtered consistently. Cover mixed, all-reserved, and invalid sidecar paths while keeping wrapper stdout out of the Step 2 dispatcher envelope.
